summary: BrilliA Inc, a NYSE American-listed intimate apparel B2B supplier, filed a 6-K furnishing a press release disclosing its acquisition of a majority equity interest in Neubodi Holdings Sdn. Bhd., a Malaysian lingerie retailer with 11 stores, effective August 1, 2026. No purchase price, stake percentage, or premium was disclosed. Co-founder Tan See See remains CEO. Neubodi targets roughly US$3 million FY2026 net sales and 10-12% net margin. The deal converts BrilliA from B2B into branded B2C retail. Watch integration execution, consideration terms, and any subsequent 6-K or 20-F disclosure detailing ownership percentage and funding.
